assessment: This paper describes the differential effects of thyroid hormone on chondrocyte maturation and mineralization at the femoral head in mice compared with the distal femur. The comprehensive set of studies were carried out in Tshr-/- hypothyroid mice through radiologic and histologic methods as well as transcriptional profiling. The conclusions are of value in understanding bone growth defects during hypothyroid states.
